classes: 18 original classes in 3 categories of 6 (CharacterClassLibrary.cpp:25,31; CharacterClassDefinition.h:13-15): mage, thief, warrior. Role: mage uses spell-point multiplier, thief uses thieving divisor, warrior uses armour and weapons (CharacterClassLibrary.cpp:20-23). Progression: health dice, initial experience cap, preferred attributes. Gear access: four armour-permission levels (CharacterClassLibrary.cpp:42-57).

8 playable races (CharacterRaceLibrary.cpp:11). One race swims at normal speed with a high stamina drain; another climbs 4 times faster (CharacterRaceLibrary.cpp:22-31). Race is a movement trait, not a combat class.
weapon_families: 18 weapons from a staff to a long bow, each with quality, base price, weight, damage min/max, handedness (ExeData.h:313-318)
14 enchantment names as a separate layer (ExeData.h:321)
gear_tiers: 3 armour families (plate, chain, leather), 11 pieces each including shields (ExeData.h:285-301)
8 material tiers with rating bonus, chance and price multiplier (ExeData.h:272-275)
material prefix in item names (ItemDefinition.h:41 comment)
zones: 10 interior archetypes: crypt, dungeon, equipment store, house, mages guild, noble house, palace, tavern, temple, tower (ArenaTypes.h:64-75)
3 chasm types: dry, wet, lava (ArenaTypes.h:143-148); lava is damaging and emissive (VoxelChasmDefinition.cpp:140-141); wet allows swimming (:139)
